title: Runtime and XDG directories are computed in six places
body:
| rule | sites |
|---|---|
| `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` with a `temp_dir` fallback | `control::viewer_socket_path`, `compositor::run` for `ChildEnv.runtime`, and a third reading in `hypr.rs` |
| `$XDG_*_HOME` with a `$HOME` fallback | `save::path` (state), `settings::path` (config), `apps::application_dirs` (data); `workspace::home` reads `HOME` a fourth time |
| create `<runtime>/decade` | `run` before `lock_server`, and `control::connect_or_start` again for the log |

`lock_path` and the log path are built as `with_file_name` siblings of the socket. `settings::load` and `save::load` have the same `read_to_string` match on `ErrorKind::NotFound` and then a version-gated `toml::from_str`; settings gates on a `toml::Table` with an `i64` version, save on a `Version` struct with a `u32`. `save` writes through a `.partial` file and a rename; `settings` writes in place.

## Proposal

`control::runtime_dir()` and `control::dir()`, the latter creating `<runtime>/decade` once, with the socket, lock and log paths as joins on it. One XDG helper taking the variable and the fallback suffix. One file helper for read-or-none, the version gate and the atomic write, so settings gains the atomic write.
